messages:
maria-cs: quick heads-up — Acme onboarding is failing: their browser SDK (behind a corporate proxy) gets 403s on authenticated calls. They say the token validates on their auth server. Anyone seen proxies strip or rewrite Authorization headers?

devon-eng: @maria-cs yep, seen this a few times. ask them for a full request/response (headers only, no secrets). corp proxies sometimes lowercase or remove headers, or add a WWW-Authenticate that confuses the client. also check for duplicate Authorization headers. is this only with ephemeral tokens or all tokens?

sam-platform: two quick checks: 1) proxy could be terminating TLS+re-encrypting and altering Host/aud which makes our token aud mismatch; 2) if many preflights flood at once our gateway may apply rate-windowing and return auth-like errors in edge cases. can you confirm the timestamps so we can correlate on our side? also try a raw curl from their network and from outside to compare.

maria-cs: attaching the minimal repro they ran (sanitized):

```
curl -i https://api.redwoodai.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_abc123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"x"}'

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json
{"error":"invalid_scope","message":"token lacks scope: embeddings.create"}
```

maria-cs: they insist the token includes embeddings scope. issuer is internal. error happens from multiple machines on their corp LAN. outside requests reportedly succeed.

devon-eng: if outside works but corp network fails, almost certainly a middlebox. ask them to check for header rewriting or injection (e.g., adding Basic auth). also ask them to decode the JWT (they can redact sub/iss) and paste the aud/exp/iat/scope claims so we can verify.

sam-platform: small thing to try on their end: set REDWOOD_PREFLIGHT_DISABLE=1 in the browser env to skip preflight coalescing (we recently pushed a tweak; unlikely but worth ruling out). and have them run curl -v to show raw headers.

onboard-bot: Quick help doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdks/browser#preflight-guide — includes proxy/hpkp notes and header-case workarounds. Please add the request-id from the 403 response (if present) so platform can correlate.

maria-cs: will request: 1) curl -v from corp and from home, 2) redacted JWT claims, 3) any request-id in the 403 response. i'll follow up when they send. thanks :thumbsup:
devon-eng: if they share an obfuscated token I can decode claims and check aud/scope quickly.
